name: Sampling and probabilistic inference
gist: Papers on generating samples from complex distributions, approximating probability distributions, and efficient Bayesian computation.
explain: Often you don't want a single answer — you want to know the full range of possibilities. For example, a weather model should not just predict the temperature tomorrow; it should say whether it could be anywhere from 60 to 80 degrees with different probabilities. A drug simulator should not just give one molecule's behavior; it should explore what might happen if conditions are slightly different. The problem is that these probability distributions (the full picture of what might happen and how likely each outcome is) are complex, with many variables interacting in tangled ways. You can't just write down the probability for every possible combination.

The hard part is that computing these probabilities exactly requires summing over all possible configurations — which can be a trillion to the power of a trillion combinations. That is not feasible. You need approximate methods that explore the space smartly, spending more computational effort on the scenarios that are likely and less on the impossible ones. The approximation has to be accurate enough that decisions based on it actually work in the world.

Researchers tackle this with sampling — techniques that generate examples from the probability distribution without computing it exactly. Some use Markov chain Monte Carlo (a method that walks through the space of possibilities in a random but intelligent way, always moving toward the likely regions and away from the impossible ones). Some use variational methods, which approximate the complex distribution with a simpler one that is easy to work with. Some use diffusion processes, which gradually add noise to a starting pattern until it becomes completely random, then learn to reverse that process. Each approach trades off speed, accuracy, and the kinds of distributions it can handle.

papers.title: Covariance estimation using Markov chain Monte Carlo
papers.contribution: Shows MCMC can achieve similar sample complexity as i.i.d. estimators with potentially much better query complexity; provides improvements for constrained and unconstrained sampling on convex bodies.

papers.title: Data-to-Energy Stochastic Dynamics
papers.contribution: First general method for Schrödinger bridges with unnormalized densities enabling sampling of posterior distributions in latent spaces of generative models without sample access.

papers.title: Hyperparameter Trajectory Inference with Conditional Lagrangian Optimal Transport
papers.contribution: Reconstructs NN behavior across hyperparameter spectra better than alternatives, enabling effective inference-time adaptation.

papers.title: Overcoming the Incentive Collapse Paradox
papers.contribution: Overcomes incentive collapse via auditing with tractable cost while jointly optimizing audit rate, sampling, and budget allocation.

papers.title: Particles Don’t Care About Z: Towards Scaling Entropy Estimation of Unnormalized Densities
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 12× and 16× lower entropy estimation error than P-SVGD and existing SVGD baselines; on CIFAR-10 energy-based generation improves FID by 80.4% with 64× higher training stability.

papers.title: PriorGuide: Test-Time Prior Adaptation for Simulation-Based Inference
papers.contribution: PriorGuide allows users to readily incorporate updated information or expert knowledge post-training, enhancing versatility of pre-trained inference models.

papers.title: Score Based Error Correcting Code Decoder
papers.contribution: Achieves best BER in 39/42 entries with average SNR gain of 0.17 dB and maximum gain of 0.46 dB; reduces end-to-end decoding time by up to 12.82%.

papers.title: Accelerated Parallel Tempering via Neural Transports
papers.contribution: Theoretically and empirically demonstrates improved sample quality, reduced computational cost compared to classical PT, and efficient free energy estimation on multimodal problems.

papers.title: Approximating Drift-Diffusion Models for User Decisions under Nudging and External Information
papers.contribution: Analytical framework enables optimization of external signal timing and extensive empirical validation of watch-time prediction.

papers.title: Bayesian Tensor Decomposition with Diffusion Model Prior
papers.contribution: Shows consistent gains over Bayesian, nonlinear, and plug-and-play baselines on image inpainting and denoising including high-resolution out-of-distribution images.

papers.title: Conditional Diffusion Sampling
papers.contribution: Achieves superior sample quality to density evaluation cost trade-offs compared to state-of-the-art samplers.

papers.title: Copula-SVI: Vine-Copula Variational Inference with Stein Refining for Instance-Level Correlation Capturing
papers.contribution: Enables efficient higher-order instance-level dependence modeling with consistent improvements over structured VI baselines on constrained clustering and time series.

papers.title: DC-LA: Difference-of-Convex Langevin Algorithm
papers.contribution: Establishes convergence to target distribution in q-Wasserstein distance for all q, improving prior work with more general framework and assumptions.

papers.title: Efficient Online Variational Estimation via Monte Carlo Sampling
papers.contribution: Demonstrates efficient online variational estimation on synthetic and real-world air-quality data with flexibility for simultaneous parameter and latent state distribution learning.

papers.title: Fair Transit Stop Placement: A Clustering Perspective and Beyond
papers.contribution: Establishes lower bounds on JR approximability and introduces parameterized algorithm enabling tunable trade-offs between JR and core.

papers.title: GPan-LoRA: Gaussian Process Amortized Networks for Bayesian Low-Rank Adaptation in Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Produces well-calibrated uncertainty under distribution shift that mitigates overconfident failures while preserving competitive task performance through scalable Gaussian Process framework.

papers.title: Information Estimation with Discrete Diffusion
papers.contribution: InfoSEDD outperforms embedding-based alternatives on motif discovery, semantic model selection, and entropy estimation tasks.

papers.title: Large-scale Uncertainty Quantification for Latent Variable Models Using Subsampling Markov Chain Monte Carlo
papers.contribution: SGLD-Gibbs with tuning guidance leads to better parameter estimates and uncertainty quantification than stochastic variational inference.

papers.title: One-shot Conditional Sampling: MMD meets Nearest Neighbors
papers.contribution: Performs competitively on synthetic complex densities and practical applications like image denoising and super-resolution with low test-time complexity.

papers.title: Path-dependent Discrete Amortized Inference
papers.contribution: Path-dependent discrete amortized inference often achieves faster convergence and improved state space exploration on standard benchmark problems versus prior Markovian approaches.

papers.title: Predictive variational inference: Learn the predictively optimal posterior distribution
papers.contribution: PVI implicitly performs hierarchical expansion to optimize predictive performance rather than Bayesian posterior approximation, with learned uncertainty detecting parameter heterogeneity for model diagnosis.

papers.title: Query-Based Asymmetric Modeling with Decoupled Input–Output Rates for Speech Restoration
papers.contribution: The unified model attains balanced fidelity-perceptual quality without redundant resampling across multiple benchmarks and sampling rates.

papers.title: SURGE: Approximation and Training Free Particle Filter for Diffusion Surrogate
papers.contribution: Provides approximation-free particle filtering that rigorously fuses observational data with diffusion model simulations for state correction.

papers.title: Score-Based Density Estimation from Pairwise Comparisons
papers.contribution: The approach enables learning complex multivariate belief densities from hundreds to thousands of pairwise comparisons using diffusion models trained on tempered samples.

papers.title: Score-Repellent Monte Carlo: Toward Efficient Non-Markovian Sampler with Constant Memory in General State Spaces
papers.contribution: SRMC achieves nearly zero-variance reduction with scaling O(1/α) as repellence strength increases and demonstrates improved estimator variance and mode coverage in continuous and discrete settings.
